description: Storage account with public blob access enabled, allowing anonymous read access to blob data

false_positive_checks.description: Should NOT flag TLS (TLS1_2 is set)

real_world_impact: Public blob access allows anyone on the internet to read blob data without authentication. This has led to numerous data breaches including exposed customer PII, backup files, and credentials.
remediation: Set allowBlobPublicAccess to false at the storage account level
